scope: Reconstructed relational nodes with shared expressions and explicit placeholder scan tables
repairs: Java reconstructs all fifteen corpus relation forms, rechecks exact descriptors and metadata, and verifies local expression identity and root reachability.
Construction uses Feldera record-kind/nullability rules. Declared output names survive optimizer rewrites; derived field types are checked before restoring the declared row object.
SEARCH normalization also flattens associative Boolean lists required by Calcite Filter construction, preserving operand order and sharing.
Uncollect outer and struct-expansion constructor flags have independent mappings.
One identity arena spans local expression fields and SQL function bodies. Shared calls and input/lambda references retain object identity across evaluation contexts.
SEARCH expansion is memoized over the original expression graph before input uses are collected. Equal distinct objects remain distinct.
Type IDs come from an immutable identity map rather than root-list offsets; later roots cannot shift earlier owner references.
Rust validates all source and input contexts, lexical lambda bindings, function parameter isolation, call signatures, relational slot counts and roles, and combined expression/function cycles.
Traversal bounds distinct object/context states separately from repeated edge and type/name comparison work.
Java independently reconstructs the intrinsic object graph, including exact classes, type identities, function declarations, call signatures, parser coordinates, and operator identities.
limitations: This is the optimized-view population, not the full stream of S1 statements or catalog objects. Complete detached S1-to-S2 remains open.

Scan tables are placeholders with declared names and row objects. Catalog declarations, quoted identifiers, schema ownership, JDBC conventions, and S1-to-S2 remain open. Contextual-use validity is checked by Rust.
Correlation/source contexts are explicit per use, but ownership by complete statement/catalog and correlation scopes is not yet transported.
Relational aggregate operators and expression operators still have separate identity arenas. Cross-arena sharing and complete system-field metadata need the complete relation adapter.
Nonempty join system fields and JDBC scans are explicitly rejected until their complete adapters exist. A separate Correlate constructor test supplies coverage outside the observed corpus.
